dominant_strengths: Clear semantic color coding via left accent bars (green/blue/amber) maps state to hue with restraint and consistency.
Toast hierarchy is well-tuned: bold title, muted timestamp, secondary description, and progress underline create scannable rhythm.
Dark canvas with subtle grid and ambient glow elevates the cards without competing with their content.
dominant_weaknesses: The 'Activity Feed' header is so dim it nearly disappears, breaking the connection between page identity and the toast stack.
Toast layout is conventional — icon, title, timestamp, close — with no novel interaction, grouping, or progressive disclosure beyond the genre baseline.
Massive empty left canvas wastes composition; the toasts feel orphaned in the bottom-right rather than anchored to any structure.
fix_priorities: Strengthen the page header contrast or remove it; current ghosting reads as a render bug, not intentional restraint.
Introduce a distinguishing system mechanic — stacking, swipe-to-snooze, grouped digests — to justify the 'system' framing.
Rebalance the canvas: either populate the left with feed history or pull toasts inward to create a deliberate anchor.
Tighten timestamp alignment and consider monospace numerals for stable vertical rhythm across notifications.
rationale.norman_balance: Strong visceral polish and solid behavioral clarity, but reflective payoff is thin — nothing here will be remembered tomorrow.
rationale.intent_fit: Yes, it executes a competent notification stack with semantic accents and clean hierarchy, though it doesn't push the pattern forward.
